documents: quote a pinned price revision, authorize a bounded hold, capture provider usage once, and release the unused balance.
captured provider cost cannot exceed the authorized hold.
every quote identifies the price revision used to calculate its maximum charge.
issue, authenticate, authorize, and revoke project-scoped virtual keys without persisting plaintext secrets.
postgresql stores only a peppered secret digest and the plaintext secret is returned only when a key is issued.
authentication compares secret digests in constant time and rejects expired, revoked, or wrong-environment keys.
verify issued virtual keys round-trip through authentication and malformed key material is rejected.
inspect signing keys, fetch signed snapshots and model catalogs, and publish reviewed control snapshots through the control plane api.
control responses are size-bounded and valid json before they are printed or written atomically.
run the authenticated control plane service that signs, publishes, and serves versioned runtime snapshots and model state.
non-public control operations pass authentication and authorization before snapshot state is read or changed.
apply, inspect, or explicitly roll back the embedded relaydock postgresql migration sequence.
migration execution uses the ordered embedded migration set and a caller-bounded context timeout.
run the expert consultation broker, persistence backend, asynchronous runner, http api, and optional remote mcp endpoint.
consultation requests return durable identities while execution continues through the owned asynchronous runner.
inspect, verify, and compact the local expert consultation store with explicit retention and dry-run controls.
dry-run compaction reports the proposed changes without mutating local consultation state.
run the authenticated ai gateway with provider routing, accounting, leases, runtime journaling, and signed control-state synchronization.
startup aborts when required database, secret, authentication, or runtime dependencies cannot be constructed safely.
run the persistent local relaydock runtime without a desktop ui and expose it through the platform-local ipc endpoint.
the headless process exposes the runtime only through the configured local ipc transport.
issue and revoke project-scoped gateway virtual keys against the authoritative postgresql control store.
the plaintext virtual-key secret is emitted only by the issue command and is never read back from storage.
run the local mcp stdio bridge that delegates expert consultation tools to the relaydock local ipc runtime.
stdout remains exclusive to mcp protocol traffic and diagnostics are written to stderr.
issue bounded, audience-specific expert mcp bearer tokens with validated scopes and optional tenant or project constraints.
issued scopes and tenant or project constraints are validated and token lifetime cannot exceed the configured maximum.
inspect durable outbox health, list dead letters, requeue one failed event, and purge bounded published history.
mutating maintenance commands require explicit bounded targets and never claim ownership of in-flight events.
run the durable outbox worker that leases pending events, publishes signed webhooks, and exposes bounded health status.
delivery attempts flow through the durable outbox repository so retries do not bypass lease and attempt state.
create or retrieve stable organization and project identities in the postgresql control catalog.
organization and project creation commit together in one database transaction under validated stable slugs.
audit, build, sign, and verify relaydock release bundles, checksums, readiness evidence, and update manifests.
signing and verification are explicit subcommands over caller-selected release artifacts rather than implicit build side effects.
run the reference signed-webhook receiver with bounded bodies, replay-safe verification, and authenticated non-loopback access.
non-loopback binding requires bearer authentication and request bodies remain within the configured maximum.
select, redact, hash, and package repository evidence before expert consultation data leaves the local boundary.
evidence content is redacted before its digest, size, and token estimate are recorded.
preview and build share the same selection and redaction path.
establish control plane principals and make deny-by-default authorization decisions for every control action.
authentication establishes identity but never grants an action without an explicit authorization decision.
tenant- or project-scoped principals cannot acquire cluster-wide publisher, gateway, or administrator authority.
verify the deny-by-default control plane role matrix and reject project-scoped privilege roles.
verify, apply, persist, and refresh signed runtime snapshots while preserving a last-known-good fallback.
an unsigned, expired, rolled-back, or content-mutated revision is never applied as current runtime state.
a last-known-good persistence failure cannot replace or invalidate an already verified active snapshot.
verify snapshot rollback, same-revision mutation, and last-known-good persistence failure handling.
define allowed consultation state transitions from context request through approval, execution, result, and terminal outcomes.
only declared state-event pairs can advance a consultation.
expose tenant-scoped remote expert tools behind bearer authentication, host, origin, body-size, and per-tool scope checks.
reading and answering consultations require distinct explicit scopes.
untrusted requests are bounded before reaching mcp handlers.
expose local expert consultation operations as mcp stdio tools backed by the authenticated local ipc runtime.
stdout is reserved for mcp protocol messages and operational logs are written only to stderr.
tool handlers delegate bounded operations to local ipc instead of running consultations synchronously.
decode provider ingress into canonical requests and encode canonical requests with explicit loss reports.
strict conversion rejects fatal information loss.
build and serve validated provider candidates for virtual and direct model routes under runtime availability state.
configured routes reference enabled providers and supported protocols.
expired signed runtime state prevents candidate selection.
coordinate candidate selection, lease acquisition, provider attempts, commit hooks, and retry termination for one canonical request.
no retry starts after an attempt has committed a semantic event.
each attempted candidate is excluded before another retry.
resolve provider and mcp destination hosts once and reject credentials, unsafe schemes, ports, and non-public addresses before dialing.
callers dial one of the already validated resolved addresses instead of repeating dns lookup.
